test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **"to."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"To"** is the correct preposition to use when indicating direction or movement towards a particular destination.
 
• The sentence is incomplete without a preposition in the blank number 3.
 
• Using** "of" **or **"for"** would not make sense in the context of the sentence.
 
• **"Towards"** could be a possible option, but **"to"** is more commonly used in this context.
 
• So, the correct answer is Option 1.
 
• Correct passage:

As a rule, you see, I'm not lugged into family rows. On the occasions when Aunt is calling Aunt like mastodons bellowing into__ primaeval swamps and Uncle James's letter about Cousin Mabel's peculiar behaviour is being shot __round__ the family circle ('Please read this carefully and send it on Jane') the clan has a tendency __**to**__ ignore me. It's one of the advantages I get from ______ (4) ______ a bachelor and, according to my nearest and dearest, practically a half-witted bachelor ______ (5) ______ that.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"Of"** is a preposition used to indicate possession or relationship between two things.
 
• **"Towards"** is a preposition used to indicate direction or movement in a particular direction.
 
• **"For"** is a preposition used to indicate purpose or intended use.
